name: diffolio
description: A considered file comparison workspace for macOS
author: Kelvin

scripts.package:app: npm run icons:build && npm run licenses:check && tauri build --bundles app
scripts.package:dmg: npm run icons:build && npm run licenses:check && tauri build --bundles app,dmg
scripts.format: prettier --write src tests scripts vite.config.mts vitest.config.mts package.json tsconfig.json src-tauri/*.json && cargo fmt --manifest-path src-tauri/Cargo.toml
scripts.format:check: prettier --check src tests scripts vite.config.mts vitest.config.mts package.json tsconfig.json src-tauri/*.json && cargo fmt --manifest-path src-tauri/Cargo.toml -- --check
scripts.release:mac: npm run icons:build && npm run licenses:check && node scripts/release-macos.mjs
scripts.release:mac:preview: npm run icons:build && npm run licenses:check && node scripts/release-macos.mjs --unsigned
